 "topology": "self-biased wide-swing NMOS cascode sink mirror (series-R biased cascode)",
 "rationale": "One resistor R carrying Iin sets the cascode gates IR above the mirror gates. This holds the bottom Vds near 0.14 V, so compliance is about Vds1+Vdsat_c ≈ 0.23 V. Rout ≈ gm_c·ro_c·ro_1 with L=2–3 µm gives >350 MΩ. Matched bottom Vds and m-ratio fingers (4:1, same gm/Id and L) keep the error under 1%. Total current is 25 µA, with no VDD use."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 8.0, 20.0),     # bottom mirror devices gm/Id
    "L1":    (3.0, 1.0, 6.0),       # bottom mirror L (ro, matching)
    "gmidc": (18.0, 10.0, 22.0),    # cascode gm/Id (low Vdsat for compliance)
    "Lc":    (2.0, 0.5, 4.0),       # cascode L
    "vds1":  (0.14, 0.09, 0.22),    # target Vds of bottom devices (set by R)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin  = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", 5e-6)
    vout = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    ratio = iout / iin
    k = max(1, int(round(1.0 / ratio)))           # 4 unit fingers on input side

    vds1 = p["vds1"]
    # bottom mirror: unit device at Iout, input = k units (same gm/Id, L -> exact W ratio)
    m1o = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iout, vds=vds1)
    m1i = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], iout * k, vds=vds1)
    # cascodes: source at vds1 (body effect), output cascode sees vout - vds1
    mco = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], iout, vds=vout - vds1, vsb=vds1)
    vgs1 = m1i.vgs
    vds_ci = max(vgs1 - vds1, 0.1)                # input cascode Vds = Vy - Vb
    mci = lut.size("n", p["gmidc"], p["Lc"], iout * k, vds=vds_ci, vsb=vds1)

    # R sets Vx - Vy so that Vb = Vy + I*R - Vgs_c = vds1
    R = (vds1 + mci.vgs - vgs1) / iin
    R = min(max(R, 100.0), 1e9)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin (x) -R- y ; cascode MCI drain y gate x ; bottom M1I gate y
    n.R("RB", "iin", "y", R)
    n.dev("MCI", "y", "iin", "b1", "vss", mci, m=k)
    n.dev("M1I", "b1", "y", "vss", "vss", m1i, m=k)
    # output branch
    n.dev("MCO", "iout", "iin", "b2", "vss", mco, m=1)
    n.dev("M1O", "b2", "y", "vss", "vss", m1o, m=1)

    # predictions
    gds1 = m1o.gds
    rout = (mco.gm + mco.gmbs + mco.gds) / (mco.gds * gds1)
    v_comp = vds1 + mco.vdsat * 0.9
    # error: residual bottom Vds mismatch is ~0, use small budget for cascode-induced mismatch
    dv_b = 0.0
    err = 100.0 * abs(dv_b * gds1 / iout) + 0.3
    power = 0.0  # vdd unused; current drawn from testbench supplies
    return n, {"iout_err_pct": err, "rout": rout, "v_compliance": v_comp,
               "power": power}
